source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: One time per battle, right before this model begins a Normal move during your Movement phase, you may trigger this: for the rest of the turn, its Move characteristic increases by 2D6" and its Solitaire weapons get +3 Attacks.
